$comment: The readings scripts/provenance-check.mjs holds its hits to (code provenance review §5.3 B1 and B2, D181). Each entry says what a flagged line or file is and which decision admitted it, and states how many hits it covers: a different count, or none, fails the check, so a new hit is read before it passes. A B1 entry names the text of the line it read, holding every marker the line matches: it covers a line of its file that contains the text and matches no marker the text lacks, so a reworded line, or one that gains a marker, is read again, and a reviewed line cannot be swapped for a new declaration (the Codex review of PR #41). A B1 entry of kind "copy" must name a package or component that COPIED in scripts/license-inventory.mjs lists for the same file, which is what puts it in THIRD_PARTY.md §2. Kinds: copy (declares registered third-party material), kit (the owner's own design kit, NOTICE.md 'Source', review P05), provenance-tooling (licence and provenance tooling, its tests and records, which name third-party sources and notices in order to check them), not-a-copy (the words mean something else here).
